note: Harrison County Conservation Board park and headquarters, 6 miles northwest of Woodbine on F20L, on a 27-acre fishing lake (electric motors only). The campground wraps the lake's narrow north arm; sites 1-6 on the south loop and the pads at the peninsula's tip sit a few steps from the shore. Electric sites with water hydrants nearby, two shower houses, swimming beach, boat ramp, fishing jetties and pier, nature center, 6 miles of trails. No dump station (use the city parks in Woodbine or Pisgah). Up to 1 RV and 1 tent per site. --Claude
